base: Probate Court fee basis: greatest of the succession-tax gross estate, the inventory, the Connecticut taxable estate or the estate-tax gross estate, plus net wrongful-death recoveries; property passing to the surviving spouse counts at 50% (C.G.S. § 45a-107(b)(1)). This file holds the court fee schedule; Connecticut has no statutory executor or attorney fee schedule.

schedules.who: Probate Court fee for settling a decedent's estate (C.G.S. § 45a-107(b)), deaths on or after July 1, 2016
schedules.capNote: Minimum $150 if a full estate is opened and the basis is under $10,000 (§ 45a-107(b)(3)); maximum $40,000.
